newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta, Southwest EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta, Southwest EPS cut.

text.p: -- NatWest analyst Susan Donfrio said she cut her fourth quarter earnings per share view for Delta Air Lines Inc to $1.35 from $1.55 and her fourth quarter EPS view for Southwest Airlines to $0.15 from $0.22.
-- She cut her full year 1997 EPS estimate on Southwest to $1.60 from $1.75.
-- She said she kept Delta rated buy and Southwest at accumulate.
-- On Delta, she said "Recent talks with management indicate ... that unit cost for the December quarter is likely to be higher than anticipated."
-- On Southwest, she said "Recent conversations with management indicate that strong traffic growth was more than offset by a decline in RASM (Passenger Revenue per Available Seat Mile)."
-- Delta was up 1-5/8 at 76-1/2 while Southwest fell 5/8 to 23-5/8.
